onboarding_subtitle: Turn your phone into a private local hub for TV, laptop, phone, tablet, and browser access.
onboarding_page_1_description: Open your videos, photos, music, and files instantly on nearby devices without uploading them anywhere first.
onboarding_page_2_description: Open on TV, laptop, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows, Android, or any other device with a browser.
onboarding_page_3_description: The receiving device only needs your local link or QR code. No extra app is required on the other device.
onboarding_page_4_description: Send files out, let people receive them, and collect files back from connected devices during the same session.
onboarding_page_5_description: Everything works over the same Wi-Fi network or your phone hotspot, so local sharing stays fast and reliable.
onboarding_page_6_description: Your data stays on your device with no cloud upload, no account, and no remote internet access in this build.

help_about_1: DirectServe lets nearby devices open your shared files in a browser without needing cloud storage or an account.
help_about_2: It is platform-independent for receivers, so any device with Wi-Fi or hotspot access and a browser can connect.
help_about_3: No cloud. No account. No internet required.
help_line_share_files: Share videos, photos, music, documents, and folders from your phone.
help_line_open_session: Open the session in a browser on Android phones, iPhone, iPad, Windows laptops, Mac, Linux, tablets, desktops, and many smart TVs.
help_line_same_network: Any device with Wi-Fi or hotspot access and a browser can connect on the same local network.
help_line_multiple_browse: Keep one share open while several devices browse at the same time.
help_line_video_direct: Most videos can play directly in the browser.
help_line_video_temporary: Some videos need a temporary browser-ready version for smoother playback on certain devices.
help_line_video_original: The original file stays on your phone, and playback preparation does not replace your source file.
help_line_prep_optional: Browser preparation is optional and mainly helps videos that need conversion open faster in some browsers.
help_line_prep_control: You can start preparation when you want it, stop it any time, and keep watching while it runs.
help_line_prep_batch: Larger batches can take longer and may warm the phone a little, so it is best used only when needed.
help_line_receive_upload: Other devices can send files to your phone through the web view when uploads are allowed.
help_line_receive_approval: If upload approval is turned on, you will see a request before the files are accepted.
help_line_receive_history: Received files are saved on your device and can appear in your history.
help_line_drop_zone: On the browser upload page, people can drag files into the drop zone to send them to your phone.
help_line_drop_zone_pick: They can also choose files manually if drag and drop is not available on that browser.
help_line_drop_zone_local: Uploads stay inside your active local session and save into the device Downloads area.
help_line_multi_connect: More than one device can connect to the same session.
help_line_multi_live: The live session screen shows connected devices, activity, and the generated device names with IP addresses.
help_line_multi_controls: You can block devices, disconnect everyone, or protect the session with a PIN.
help_line_privacy_local: DirectServe does not require an account and does not move your library into cloud storage.
help_line_privacy_session: Nearby devices only see the files and folders that are part of your current live session.
help_line_privacy_controls: You can stop sharing, turn on a PIN, block devices, disable downloads, or stop browser preparation whenever you want.
help_line_wifi_hotspot: Both devices should be on the same Wi-Fi network or your phone hotspot.
help_line_public_wifi: Public Wi-Fi sometimes blocks local device-to-device traffic, so hotspot is often the best fallback.
help_line_downloads_disabled: If downloads are disabled in Settings, the web UI hides download actions completely.
help_line_flow_3: 3. Open the shown link or scan the QR code on another device.
help_line_flow_4: 4. Browse, play, preview, or upload files depending on what the host allows.

dlna_intro_title: Stream to Smart TVs and media players
dlna_intro_body: DLNA lets nearby Smart TVs, gaming consoles, VLC, and Kodi discover this phone as a media server on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot.
dlna_status_enabled: DLNA is on. Start a sharing session from the home screen to make this phone visible.
dlna_status_disabled: DLNA is off. Turn it on to be discoverable when a sharing session is active.
dlna_step_tv_1: 1. Make sure your TV is on the same Wi-Fi network as this phone.
dlna_step_tv_2: 2. On this phone, start a sharing session from the home screen.
dlna_step_tv_3: 3. On your TV, open the media or source menu (sometimes called \"Inputs\", \"Apps\", or \"Media\").
dlna_step_tv_4: 4. Look for \"DirectServe Media Server\" in the source list and select it.
dlna_step_tv_5: 5. Browse your shared videos, music, and photos directly from the TV remote.
dlna_step_vlc_1: 1. Open VLC on your laptop, desktop, or mobile device.
dlna_step_vlc_2: 2. Go to View → Playlist (desktop) or open the side menu (mobile).
dlna_step_vlc_3: 3. Look for \"Universal Plug \'n\' Play\" or \"Local Network\" in the sidebar.
dlna_step_vlc_4: 4. Select \"DirectServe Media Server\" from the discovered devices.
dlna_step_vlc_5: 5. Browse and play your shared media directly inside VLC.
dlna_other_apps: Works with Kodi, Windows Media Player, PlayStation, Xbox, and most modern Smart TVs that support DLNA or UPnP.
dlna_trouble_1: If your TV does not see this phone, make sure both are on the same Wi-Fi network or hotspot.
dlna_trouble_2: Public Wi-Fi sometimes blocks device-to-device discovery. Use your phone hotspot as a reliable fallback.
dlna_trouble_3: DLNA only works while a sharing session is active. Start a session from the home screen first.
onboarding_page_7_description: Share quick messages and links between your phone and connected browsers. Turn it on in Settings to let browsers send you text instantly with notifications.
onboarding_page_8_description: Stream your phone screen to nearby devices. Add PIN protection during a live mirror session to control who can watch, and regenerate the PIN anytime.

help_line_live_screen_pin_manual: Set a custom PIN in Settings if you prefer a specific code instead of auto-generated ones.
